citations.assertion: Head/gamekeeper; family identity evidence. At Hass, Crawford, William 72 widower, gamekeeper, born Crawford; daughter Isabella 42, son James 30 assistant to keeper, daughters Agness 24 and Anne 22, all Crawford-born. No George in this household; absence is not proof of his adult location. William Glasgow: Head/gamekeeper; family identity evidence Reviewed 2026-10-31; Crawford family source receipts, reviewed 31 October 2026; private bundle retained.
